nodes.title: First-year Student Honors Seminar
nodes.description: Weekly seminars with faculty members from a variety of disciplines (chosen by the provost to match the interests of participating students). This seminar provides students with opportunities to learn more about research and scholarly activities being conducted by faculty and instill in students a sense of participation in the scholarly life at UC San Diego. P/NP grades only.
